answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to expend computational energy to validate a block. Like a digital quill signing a ledger, this process demands a pearl of verifiable effort to prevent identity spoofing. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake agents must secure massive hash power, a cost that scales like a spreading nebula of resource consumption, ultimately rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible against the chain.
